disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER DATA. These device prices and carrier plan terms are rough estimates entered to demonstrate the acquisition-advisor engine. Every option carries verify:true and its own as_of date. Do not present these numbers to a user as researched fact until an operator has confirmed each one against the seller and carrier.

options.label: Buy outright + BYOD unlimited plan
notes: Costco / Best Buy gift-card bundles knock ~3-5% off the device vs Apple full price.
BYOD premium 'unlimited' (~100GB full speed, then throttled) runs ~50-60/mo on a flanker.

options.label: Carrier 0% financing (24 mo) + premium plan w/ device credit
notes: 0% APR: total device cost equals retail. The value is keeping ~1,500 cash for 2 years and getting the carrier's core network + (for a business account) priority support.
Device credit typically lasts the 24-mo term, then the plan reverts to full price.

options.label: Bring-It-Back (24 mo) + premium plan w/ device credit
notes: Lower monthly because ~550 is deferred to a balloon at month 24 — pay it to own, or return the device in good condition and upgrade.
Return condition is strict: any crack or excess wear triggers a fee.
Only competitive if you genuinely replace the device every ~24 months.

options.label: Previous gen (Apple Certified Refurbished) + BYOD
notes: One generation back (iPhone 16 Pro), ~23% off, full Apple warranty on refurbished units.
The pure-value pick if you don't need the newest chip / camera.
